//: Host-side orchestrator settings. Copy to config/orchestrator.json. Identity (slug, repo, default_branch, trigger_label) stays in projects.json; this file only adds what the queue has no business knowing.

main-app.//: local_path only seeds the mirror cache cheaply on first clone; it is never mounted into a runner.
main-app.//git_urls: Optional clone_url or fetch_url for the host mirror, e.g. git@github.com:my-org/primary-app.git (ssh-agent). Runner pushes stay HTTPS + GITHUB_TOKEN unless push_url is set.

neon.//: Omit this whole block for projects that need no database branch.
neon.//init_source: parent-schema copies schema only. Switch to parent-data only if the agent genuinely needs seeded rows; it copies the parent's entire dataset into a database the agent can read.

main-app.//env_template: Merged into .env.local on execute tasks only, with DATABASE_URL and GITHUB_ISSUE_NUMBER the orchestrator adds. Never put a real secret here; avoid host localhost URLs.
main-app.//posthog: Optional. Requires POSTHOG_MCP_API_KEY in .env.orchestrator. Pins the runner to this PostHog project (read-only unless read_only is false).
